title: LeadFlow V2 — API-Based Lead Qualification & Workflow Automation
description: Built LeadFlow V2, an API-backed lead qualification workflow and interactive CRM demonstration. Cloudflare Pages Functions validate synthetic leads, apply explainable scoring, route decisions, and return timed execution traces. I engineered the responsive frontend, sandbox CRM contract, browser-local upserts, JSON receipts, and fault-injection tests. A five-act cinematic player turns verified server results into an interactive story with scrubbing, replay, and reduced-motion support. External CRM writes, LLM inference, and messaging are not connected.
